- 🏔️ Snow-capped mountain peaks bathed in golden hour light
- 🌅 Warm orange and pink sunset hues across the sky
- 🌲 Pine trees scattered along a peaceful shoreline

If you'd like any adjustments—such as a different time of day, season, aspect ratio, or artistic style—just let me know!

اینم عکس ماینکرافت با ارم سریال ÇUKUR به رنگ سبز و نوشته kill_pv2 بالای عکس:

![Minecraft ÇUKUR Logo](https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/Minecraft%20style%20digital%20art%2C%20blocky%20pixelated%20aesthetic%20like%20the%20video%20game%20Minecraft%2C%20Turkish%20TV%20series%20%C3%87UKUR%20logo%20prominently%20displayed%20in%20the%20center%20in%20bright%20green%20color%2C%20the%20%C3%87UKUR%20pit%20symbol%20rendered%20in%20Minecraft%20blocks%20and%20green%20tones%2C%20text%20%22kill_pv2%22%20written%20in%20bold%20Minecraft-style%20font%20on%20the%20top%20of%20the%20image%2C%20Minecraft%20character%20or%20scene%20background%20with%20Turkish%20neighborhood%20vibes%2C%20dramatic%20cinematic%20lighting%2C%20green%20themed%20color%20palette%2C%20high%20quality%20game%20screenshot%20style%2C%20detailed%20voxel%20art?width=1024&height=1024&nologo=true&seed=525456)

ویژگی‌های عکس:
- 🎮 استایل voxel/minecraft با بافت بلاکی
- 🟢 لوگوی ÇUKUR به رنگ سبز در وسط
- ✍️ نوشته **kill_pv2** در بالای تصویر

اگه می‌خوای تغییر بدم—مثلاً رنگ دیگه، پس‌زمینه متفاوت، یا استایل خاص‌تر—بگو برات درست کنم!
